# Nimbus agent marketplace

A catalog of developer plugins maintained by Nimbus Labs and friends.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add demo_nimbus-labs/agent-marketplace
/plugin install test-writer@nimbus-plugins
```

# Write Tests

## Steps
1. Find the functions changed in the working tree.
2. Detect the test framework from the project files.
3. Write one test per behavior, including edge cases.
4. Run the tests and fix failures before finishing.
